data.name: AlFayyad
data.gender_notes: AlFayyad is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word ‘Al-Fa’id’, meaning ‘the trustworthy one’, ‘the doer’, ‘the helper’, or ‘the one who delivers’. This name carries a significant spiritual meaning in Islam, symbolizing faithfulness, reliability, and trustworthiness. The name AlFayyad carries the meaning “The Trustworthy One” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose AlFayyad usually hope their child will grow to embody the trustworthy one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that embodies trust and faith in Allah.
data.etymology: AlFayyad belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “The Trustworthy One.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of AlFayyad total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
